people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: All countries came into Egypt, to Joseph, to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all the earth.
translations.bsb: And every nation came to Joseph in Egypt to buy grain, because the famine was severe over all the earth.
translations.kjv: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.
translations.asv: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph to buy grain, because the famine was sore in all the earth.
